ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:0.original: Hey! Hey! You two, hello! Over here!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:0.translation: Эй! Эй! Вы двое, привет! Сюда!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:1.original: Huh? Is that someone calling to us? Or am I just hearing things?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:1.translation: А? Это кто-то зовёт нас? Или мне послышалось?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:2.original: No, I hear it too. Sounds like it's coming from over there.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:2.translation: Нет, я тоже слышу. Кажется, доносится оттуда.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:3.original: Hehehe, welcome. I'm so glad you are here.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:3.translation: Хе-хе-хе, добро пожаловать. Я так рада, что вы здесь.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:4.original: What's going on here? Was that you, just now?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:4.translation: Что здесь происходит? Это была ты только что?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:5.original: Yes. I'm so bored, I was wondering if you'd play with me?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:5.translation: Да. Мне так скучно — не поиграете ли со мной?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:6.original: Sure, I think we can play some...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:6.translation: Конечно, думаю, мы можем немного поиграть...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:7.original: Hehe! Great, that sounds perfect! In which case...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе! Отлично, как раз то что нужно! В таком случае...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:9.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:9.original: Hold on! Firis? Uwah, you've gotten so big I didn't recognize you!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:9.translation: Погоди! Фирис? Ува, ты так выросла, что я тебя не узнала!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:10.original: Palmyra? You know this girl, Firis?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:10.translation: Пальмира? Ты знаешь эту девочку, Фирис?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:11.original: Yes, she's my friend. Palmyra, this is Lydie and Sue. They're alchemists too.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:11.translation: Да, она моя подруга. Пальмира, это Лиди и Сью. Они тоже алхимики.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:12.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:12.original: Wow, alchemists! Now this sounds like a fight worth fighting!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:12.translation: Ого, алхимики! Вот это уже бой, ради которого стоит сражаться!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:13.original: What? A fight? I thought you just wanted to play...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:13.translation: Что? Бой? А я думала, ты просто хочешь поиграть...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:14.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:14.original: I do! Play at combat, until one side is defeated!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:14.translation: Так и есть! Играть в бой, пока одна сторона не будет побеждена!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:15.original: W-Whaaaat! You should have started with that!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_010.ebm:15.translation: Ч-чтоооо! Надо было с этого начинать!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_020.ebm:0.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_020.ebm:0.original: Ah! Found you! So happy you've come to see me again. Let's get right back to our game!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_020.ebm:0.translation: Ах! Нашла вас! Так рада, что вы снова ко мне пришли. Сразу вернёмся к нашей игре!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:1.original: H-How did you get to be so strong? Are you some kind of warrior from history or something?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:1.translation: К-как ты стала такой сильной? Ты какая-то воин из истории, что ли?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:2.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, she's not a warrior. Palmyra is more like, well, a goddess?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:2.translation: Ха-ха-ха, она не воин. Пальмира больше похожа... ну, на богиню?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:4.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:4.original: Yes. There are even legends that she's the one who created this world.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:4.translation: Да. Есть даже легенды, что именно она создала этот мир.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:5.original: So being rude to her could, what? Get us turned into two Puni?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:5.translation: Так грубость с ней может... что? Превратить нас в двух Пуни?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:6.original: Uwah, no thanks! Goddess Palmyra, I'm so sorry!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:6.translation: Ува, нет уж, спасибо! Богиня Пальмира, прости нас!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:7.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:7.original: Enough of that. You can still just call me Palmyra, please. We're friends now, after all!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:7.translation: Хватит об этом. Зовите меня просто Пальмирой, пожалуйста. В конце концов, мы теперь друзья!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:8.original: That makes me happy to hear, but I don't think we should act so familiar with a goddess...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:8.translation: Приятно это слышать, но не думаю, что нам стоит так фамильярно обращаться с богиней...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:9.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:9.original: If I'm the goddess, then I decide the rules, right? So please, do as I ask!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:9.translation: Если я богиня, то правила устанавливаю я, верно? Так что, пожалуйста, сделайте, как я прошу!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:10.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:10.original: In fact, if you do keep on being all weird, I'll turn you into spider crickets!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:10.translation: А если будете и дальше вести себя странно — превращу вас в сверчков-пауков!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:11.original: Spider crickets! Uwah, that's worse than Puni! Alright, alright, Palmyra it is!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:11.translation: Сверчки-пауки! Ува, это хуже Пуни! Ладно-ладно, Пальмира так Пальмира!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:12.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:12.original: Good, that's the way! This is the start of a long friendship, Lydie, Sue!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:12.translation: Вот так лучше! Это начало долгой дружбы, Лиди, Сью!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:14.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:14.original: Wow, anyway, after all this fun I'm exhausted. Sorry, I'm going to take a break.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:14.translation: Ого, впрочем, после всего этого веселья я вымотана. Простите, я немного отдохну.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:15.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:15.original: I'll be wandering around here when I'm awake. Come and play with me any time. Goodnight!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:15.translation: Когда проснусь, буду бродить здесь. Приходите играть в любое время. Спокойной ночи!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:16.original: H-Hahaha. I didn't expect to find a goddess in our circle of friends!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:16.translation: Х-ха-ха-ха. Не ожидала найти богиню в нашем кругу друзей!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:17.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:17.original: I was surprised too, at first. After spending some time with her, though, she's just a regular girl.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:17.translation: Я тоже сначала удивилась. Но пообщавшись с ней какое-то время — она просто обычная девочка.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:18.original: Don't think about it too much, just relax and enjoy.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_030.ebm:18.translation: Не думайте слишком много — просто расслабьтесь и наслаждайтесь.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_040.ebm:0.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_040.ebm:0.original: Ah, you're back! Let the play fighting begin!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_040.ebm:0.translation: Ах, вы вернулись! Да начнётся игровая драка!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:0.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:0.original: That was fun! That's for playing with me! Here's a token of my thanks. Haaaaaaaaaah! Hah!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:0.translation: Это было весело! Спасибо, что поиграли со мной! Вот знак моей благодарности. Хаааааааа! Ха!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:1.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:1.original: Right, I'm going to nap for a while. Please do come again.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_050.ebm:1.translation: Ладно, я немного вздремну. Пожалуйста, заходите ещё.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:0.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:0.original: Humm? Hmmm? Lydie, Sue... You've met Termina, haven't you?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:0.translation: Хм? Хмм? Лиди, Сью... Вы встречались с Терминой, не так ли?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:1.original: Yes, we have, but how did you know?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:1.translation: Да, встречались, но откуда ты узнала?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:3.original: We do? I've washed since then, thank you very much!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:3.translation: Пахнем? Между прочим, я с тех пор мылась, спасибо большое!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:4.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:4.original: Hahaha, enough about personal hygiene. How much do you know about who Termina is?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха-ха, хватит о личной гигиене. Как много вы знаете о том, кто такая Термина?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:5.original: Not much. She's very powerful, sure, but we don't know much more than that.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:5.translation: Мало. Она очень сильная, конечно, но большего мы не знаем.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:6.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:6.original: Termina, you see, is like my counterpart. My opposite. I create, and she destroys.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:6.translation: Термина, видите ли, как мой антипод. Моя противоположность. Я создаю — она разрушает.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:8.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:8.original: Yes. Even though she often doesn't desire it, she's just too strong, meaning she breaks things anyway.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:8.translation: Да. Даже когда она этого не хочет, она слишком сильна — и всё равно что-нибудь ломает.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:9.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:9.original: That's led her to keep away from people. She really is kind, though, at heart...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:9.translation: Поэтому она держится подальше от людей. Хотя в душе она по-настоящему добрая...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:11.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:11.original: This might be odd, coming from me, but I hope you'll both be Termina's friends.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:11.translation: Может, странно слышать это от меня, но я надеюсь, вы обе станете друзьями Термины.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:12.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:12.original: I know she can be obstinate, but she also gets very lonely...
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:12.translation: Знаю, она бывает упрямой, но ей также бывает очень одиноко...

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:13.original: Hehe, sure thing! We can't turn down a request from a friend!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:13.translation: Хе-хе, конечно! Мы не откажем в просьбе подруге!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:14.original: We like Termina too, after all! Leave it to us, Palmyra!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:14.translation: Нам ведь и самим нравится Термина! Оставь это нам, Пальмира!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:15.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_060.ebm:15.original: Thank you! I'll leave Termina in your hands!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:0.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:0.original: Hey, Lydie! Sue! You've become friends with Termina, haven't you!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:0.translation: Эй, Лиди! Сью! Вы подружились с Терминой, да!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:1.original: Yes, that's right. You hear things quickly, don't you?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:1.translation: Да, так и есть. Ты быстро всё узнаёшь, да?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:2.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:2.original: That's the power of the divine! I'm joking, actually. She came to see me.
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:2.translation: Это сила божества! Шучу, вообще-то. Она сама ко мне пришла.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:3.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:3.original: She was really happy, boasting about making some friends!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:3.translation: Она была очень счастлива и хвасталась, что завела друзей!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:4.original: Hahaha, great! I'm glad to hear it.

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:5.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:5.original: It's good, isn't it? Thank you so much for your kindness to Termina!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:5.translation: Правда же, хорошо? Огромное спасибо за вашу доброту к Термине!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:6.speaker: Luard
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:6.original: I don't know if you'll consider this a reward, but I'll show you my own true power if you like?
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:6.translation: Не знаю, сочтёте ли вы это наградой, но если хотите — я покажу вам свою истинную силу?

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:8.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:8.original: Ta-dah! Hahaha! This is my true power!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:8.translation: Та-дам! Ха-ха-ха! Это моя истинная сила!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:9.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:9.original: A thousand times the strength, a thousand times the magic! Now the fun can really start!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:9.translation: В тысячу раз больше силы, в тысячу раз больше магии! Теперь веселье по-настоящему начнётся!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:10.original: H-H-Hold on! No need for that, Palmyra! No need to do that on our account, you can just turn back!
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:10.translation: П-п-погоди! Не надо, Пальмира! Ради нас не нужно — можешь просто вернуться!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:11.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:11.original: Oh, it's no trouble! Let's fight!

ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:13.speaker: Alt's Passionate Fan
ebm:ms03/event_message_ms03_070.ebm:13.original: Hahahaha! Defeat me if you can!
